batting.name: Ashutosh Sharma
batting.dismissal: c A Manohar b E Malinga

balls.text: yes, he can! A final flourish, and the Capitals finish on 133! Misses the yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side, on middle and leg. Stubbs gets his front foot out of the way and muscles it to long on's right. Something to cheer about right at the end, but there is no denying or escaping who the happier side will be at this stage!
has a shy at the stumps, and misses! Yorker just outside off. Starc digs it out towards the bowler and runs to get Stubbs on strike. Malinga chances his arm and fails to hit bullseye

miscued and taken comfortably on the fence! Off-pace and banged in so short outside off that Malinga's toe-nail was in danger for a while. The ball gets up high, well above the batter's right shoulder and Ashutosh has to fetch it, while also making all the pace. Fails to do so and offers the simplest of catches to Manohar at deep mid wicket. The plan comes off, and Ashutosh departs after a solid knock!
slower ball on a full length just outside off. Stubbs, sitting deep in his crease, drop-kicks it on the bounce to mid wicket
low full toss on off stump. Ashutosh backs away early and laces it straight to the sweeper at deep cover. He will feel he missed out there, especially with extra cover and mid off up
Malinga sticks to the short-ball ploy, bowling this wide outside off. Ashutosh fetches it and forehands it over the bowler's head. Just a brace, though
another slower ball banged into the track outside off. Stubbs moves across, swipes at it with all his might but only swats away a few flies. That was slow. Incredibly slow.
back of a length wide outside off. Ashutosh shuffles across, shaping for the scoop but jams it into his body. The ball rolls away towards where the tramlines are, and DC sneak in a run
slower bouncer on off stump. Stubbs jumps up into the air to roll his wrists over it and pulls it towards deep square leg
dug into the track outside off. Ashutosh rises with the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
on-pace, on a back of a length wide outside off. Ashutosh looks for the reverse-ramp but that seems like an afterthought. Misses the ball in the end
fetch that too, says Ashutosh Sharma! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Ashutosh gets his front hip out of the way and slugs it over the bowler's head!

amazing stroke-making! This is almost a perfect yorker, tailing into leg stump. Stubbs, though, gives himself room and then cracks it to sweeper cover's right. Malinga bowled a fairly decent ball, but Stubbs was just too good on that occasion!
another short ball outside off. Ashutosh opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Ashutosh tries to dab it down to deep third but the lack of pace means he only gloves it on the bounce to the keeper
excellent yorker just outside off. Stubbs has a swing at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg. Ashutosh has to scurry for the single but gets there in the end
splits the field perfectly! Slower bumper outside off. Stubbs picks it early, jumps up onto his toes and rolls his wrists to place this surgically between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!

oh, almost a wicket! Into the blockhole outside off. Stubbs digs it out towards the bowler and hits the stumps at the other end. Malinga stretched out his right hand but could not get anything behind it. Had he done so, Ashutosh would have been walking back
up and over now! And Ashutosh is coming after the Sunrisers! Right in the slot on middle and off. Ashutosh gets under it and lifts it with minimal fuss over mid off!
shot! On-pace and width on offer, and that is a recipe for trouble. Ashutosh brings those fast hands into play and scythes it past backward point!
another slower bumper outside off but this loops over the batter's head, despite him trying to upper-cut it. Left alone and called a wide
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Stubbs waits for it and short-arm jabs it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Ashutosh steers it enough to extra cover's left and picks up a single
hard length again, angling into off stump. Ashutosh stays back but with the lack of room, he cannot jab it past extra cover
back of a length outside off. Ashutosh hangs back and punches it straight to mid off
short and a mile outside off. Ashutosh lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some exercise
back of a length on leg stump. Stubbs tucks it off his hips through the vacant square leg region and canters back for two
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
hard length, slanting into the body. Ashutosh is cramped for room and drops it into the on side for a single

slower bumper angling into off stump. Comes off very sluggishly and Ashutosh has to wait a fair bit before upper-cutting it over the keeper's head. Malinga misfields, running around from deep third, and concedes the second
back of a length outside off. Stubbs goes fishing at it and edges it down to deep third for another single
dug into the track just outside off. Ashutosh stays leg side of the ball and chops it down to deep third
fizzed in on a length on leg stump. Stubbs gets onto the front foot and defends

safe! Back of a length outside leg stump. Ashutosh looks to turn it towards deep mid wicket but the lack of pace off the surface means he gets a leading edge. The ball lobs up and lands into the vacant mid wicket region
plenty of hang-time, and plenty of distance too! Floated up outside off. Ashutosh comes out of his bunker for the second time this over and smokes it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on off. Sticks in the surface a little and straightens. Ashutosh plonks it off the back foot into the off side
Ashutosh dances down the track, and announces himself! Given a hint of air just outside off. Ashutosh gets close enough to the pitch of the ball, goes through the line and launches it over long on!
shortish on middle and off. Stubbs goes back and knocks it to long off
slower bumper outside off. Ashutosh has to fetch it and shanks it towards mid wicket
slower ball on a length outside off. Stubbs presses forward and eases it to long on
shortish outside off. Ashutosh gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep point
dug into the track just outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and punches it towards long on
back of a length in the channel. Ashutosh drops it into the off side and calls his partner through for an easy single
back of a length on middle and leg. Stubbs lets the ball arrive before tugging it enough to mid wicket's right
fired in on a length on leg stump. Stubbs opts to stay back and knocks it to long off
tossed up full on middle and off. Ashutosh presses forward and pushes it to long off
slower on a length wide outside off. Stubbs reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Ashutosh goes back and dabs it with soft hands towards short third
back of a length outside off. Stubbs hangs back and jabs it towards deep point

oh my goodness - that is a run-out of catastrophic proportions! Back of a length on the stumps. Stubbs tucks it towards deep mid wicket and is always intent on two. In fact, he is so intent that he runs the second all by himself, with Nigam not even moving a muscle at the other end. Stubbs, eventually, passes Nigam at the batter's end, which means that Nigam has to sacrifice his wicket for the senior batter. Good work by Verma on the deep mid wicket fence, and DC sink further into trouble!
slower bumper on off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
slower ball on a full length outside off. Nigam sits deep in his crease and runs it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Stubbs transfers his weight onto the front foot and drives it on the up to deep point
Stubbs with his first boundary too! Juicy thigh-high full toss, which also drifts onto the pads. Stubbs uses the pace and helps it away fine!
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs presses half forward and taps it gently towards extra cover
shortish outside off. Stubbs reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
flighted up again, full on middle and off. Nigam gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards extra cover
into the blockhole just outside leg. Nigam digs it out towards mid wicket
tossed up generously on a full length on middle and off. Nigam backs away and drills it past extra cover. Long off puts in the slide very early but cuts it off in the end
floated up full just outside leg. Stubbs stretches forward and pushes it towards long off
back of a length on middle and leg. Holds in the surface and Nigam tugs it uppishly towards long on
back of a length on leg stump. Stubbs gives himself a touch of room and punches it to long off
edged and four! And the runs are suddenly flowing now! Back of a length on middle and off. Nigam looks to cut it off the stumps and gets an outside edge that races away past short third!
back of a length on middle and off. Nigam gives himself a bit of room and jabs it off the back foot towards extra cover
fizzed in on a length outside off. Nigam, caught on the crease, wafts at it without any footwork and sees the ball breeze past his blade
back of a length on off. Nigam hangs back and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Nigam has a waft at it and gets a thick outside edge that dribbles away behind point
first six of the innings, and it has taken more than nine overs for DC to find it! This is a real long-hop on middle and leg. Nigam rocks back and pounds it over cow corner!

oh dear - that falls right in between two fielders! Loopy full toss on leg stump. Nigam is way too early into the stroke and lobs it up. Mid wicket runs back, deep mid wicket runs in, but both of them see the ball land right between them. Verma, at mid wicket, seemed in play for a moment, but also seemed to slip just as the ball dropped. Not sure if he would have gotten there anyway
banged into the track on middle and leg. Hurries onto Stubbs, who cloths his pull to mid wicket's right. Just another single
full just outside off. Stubbs gets onto the front foot and cracks it back towards the bowler, who gets something behind it and that takes the sting out of the stroke. Cut off by long on
just over! Slot ball outside off and Nigam's eyes light up. He looks to go over mid off but scuffs it a touch. Fortunately for him and DC< it just clears the back-tracking Cummins
angled in full on leg stump. Stubbs looks to flick it away but seems to play all around it. Rolls off the pad into the on side for a leg bye
into the blockhole on middle and off. Nigam digs it out into the off side and looks at his partner, who responds and completes the single comfortably
slower bumper outside off that takes a couple of business days to arrive. Stubbs has a swat at it but is, unsurprisingly, too early into the stroke
back of a length outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and pats it towards extra cover
back of a length on leg stump. Nigam lets the ball come to him before working it towards deep square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Nigam stays leg side of the ball and taps it towards backward point
back of a length, honing into off stump. Nigam gets behind the line well and presents the full face of the bat

nicked and taken! Another catch for Ishan Kishan, and the Capitals plunge further into crisis! Angled in full just outside off. Rahul looks to drive it down the ground but the ball straightens just enough to take the outside edge. Beautiful, beautiful bowling, and equally impressive work behind the stumps, with Kishan snaffling that up to his right. Rahul shakes his head as he walks back, and DC are in all sorts here!
loopy thigh-high full toss on leg stump. Stubbs is taken by surprise and turns it tamely towards mid wicket
zipped in full on middle and leg. Rahul gets a good stride in and drives it crisply towards long on
very full on middle and leg. Rahul jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover
slanted in full on leg stump. Stubbs gets onto the front foot and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Rahul stays on top of the bounce and jabs it towards deep point
did that carry?! Fullish on middle and off. Rahul presses forward and drives slightly uppishly. Malinga gets his hands to it to his left but that may not have carried
on-pace, full length ball outside off. Stubbs gets onto the front foot and taps it gently towards cover point

does him all ends up, and Captain Fantastic can do no wrong tonight! Slower ball angled across on a length wide outside off. Axar looks for the booming drive but is too early into the stroke. The bottom hand comes off and the ball spoons up towards mid off. Cummins back-pedals, keeps his eyes on the ball and snares a smart chance over his right shoulder. DC four down inside the powerplay, and the SRH-pro crowd is thrilled to bits!
shortish outside off. Axar gets up on his toes and punches it past extra cover in crisp fashion. Deep point comes around to his left and saves two
short and wide outside off. Rahul goes back and across before cutting it towards deep point. He timed that pretty well too
back of a length outside off. Sticks in the surface and Rahul, hanging back in his crease, plonks it towards extra cover
glorious, glorious stroke! Length ball outside off and Rahul jumps onto it. Leans forward, shows the maker's name and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
hard length again, in and around off stump. Axar does not have the room to free his arms and scuffs his cut towards extra cover
shortish just outside off. Axar wants to cut this away but does not have as much room to work with. Chops it towards cover point
hard length on middle and leg. Axar gets up on his toes and stabs it down the ground towards mid off
dug into the track outside off. A quick revision after going too full the previous ball. Axar stands up on his toes and jabs it towards mid off
Axar off the mark instantly! Low full toss just outside off. Axar presses forward and times it sweetly back past the non-striker. Axar is underway!

goes straight up, and pouched by Kishan! Cummins has three in the powerplay, and the SRH captain is dealing Capital damage! On a length on leg stump and this seems to just hold in the surface. Porel looks for that pick-up stroke over square leg but the lack of pace off the surface means he gets underneath it too much. Kishan calls early, settles under the high ball and completes the catch in the short backward square leg region. Top, top catch, and a top, top start for SRH!
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this seems to straighten against the angle. Rahul wafts at it and sees the ball breeze past his flailing blade
short on the body. Porel gets inside the line and swivel-pulls it towards deep backward square leg
fullish on the pads. Rahul gets onto the front foot and flicks it on the bounce to deep square leg
hard length on the stumps. Rahul backs away, trying to force the issue through the off side but only ends up chopping it towards the keeper
back of a length, angling into the pads. Porel glances it towards long leg and picks up another single
shortish on leg stump. Rahul hops up onto his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Porel rises with the bounce and punches it towards mid on
Porel counter-punches! On a length on the pads and that is right where Porel wants it. He transfers his weight forward and swings it away over square leg!
back of a length on off. Porel gets up on his toes and meets the ball right under his eyes
back of a length just outside off. Rahul drops it into the off side and calls his partner through for a single
what an effort! SRH are here, folks! Fullish outside off. Rahul gets onto the front foot and plays the silkiest of drives, only to be thwarted by a flying Sachin Baby at extra cover

edged and Kishan gobbles it up! Cummins is on absolute fire, and they cannot play him! Banged into the track on middle and off, perhaps anticipating du Plessis charging down the track. He does so anyway and then has an agricultural mow across the line. Only manages a faint tickle and Kishan was never going to drop that. Cummins wheels away in celebration, du Plessis looks at his bat, and those in orange in the stands are thoroughly enjoying themselves!
back of a length outside off. Porel hops up onto his toes and jabs it towards cover point

oh dear - du Plessis has gotten away with one there! Shortish on leg stump. du Plessis opens up his stance and hacks across the line again. Clinks it badly towards long on and he jogs along for the single. Long on takes aim at the bowler's end and hits the stumps, but du Plessis has just made it
hard length on middle and off. More extra bounce and du Plessis has to soften his bottom hand to run that down to short third
well well! Back of a length on middle and leg. du Plessis skips down the track and has a wild hack across the line. Only connects with the fresh Hyderabad air
hard length on middle and off. Porel gets up on his toes and glances it towards short fine leg
shortish outside off. du Plessis waits on it and uses the angle to dab it down to short third
slanted in on a length on middle and off. du Plessis tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end. Off the mark with a single
back of a length in the channel. A hint of nip back and du Plessis, fencing at it from his crease, chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
back of a length on leg stump. A bit of extra bounce and du Plessis fends it into the on side with soft hands
back of a length and sliding well down leg. du Plessis lets it go in the end and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length on middle and leg. Porel lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
on a length, angled across just outside off. Porel stretches forward and pushes it towards cover point

nicked and gone! Cummins breaks through straightaway and there is a massive roar around the Rajiv Gandhi Stadium in Hyderabad! Back of a length in the sixth stump channel and this seems to nip away just a smidgen. Nair goes feeling for it away from his body and feathers it through to Kishan. The crowd erupts, and this is the start of dreams for SRH!
